## Purpose

## Scientific Contract

- [ ] This change does not alter frozen prompts, splits, responses, targets, hashes, denominators, evaluator outcomes, or reported benchmark results.
- [ ] Any intentional scientific change is explicitly versioned and documented.
- [ ] No credential, private provider response, local personal path, unpublished manuscript, or manuscript-facing derivative is included.

## Validation

- [ ] Integration tests pass.
- [ ] Release-parity checks pass when applicable.
- [ ] Ruff and mypy pass.
- [ ] Documentation builds with `mkdocs build --strict` when applicable.
